units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: PulseFit members app for iOS (16+) and Android (API 26+). Members book group classes, check in at the club door with a QR code and manage their membership. Backend: Brightloop API on top of ClubDesk (members, classes) and Paystride (billing).

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Door check-in by QR at all 7 PulseFit clubs: Northside, Riverside, Eastgate, Millbrook, Old Town, Harbour, Kingsway.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Class timetable per club, class card with instructor and photo, booking, cancellation, waitlist. Bookings open 7 days ahead at 07:00.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Member shows a rotating QR code (changes every 30 s). The front desk tablet or a door reader scans it.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Current plan, next payment date, payment history (from Paystride), freeze request, upgrade request.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: PT session booking is in v1: list of trainers per club, free slots, book and pay in the app.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Sign-in with membership number and a 4-digit PIN, same as the club kiosks. 5 wrong tries lock the account for 15 minutes.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Class reminders: push notification and email, 2 hours before the class starts. Waitlist promotion: email.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: No marketing pushes in v1. Opt-in screen comes in phase 2.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Members can cancel a booked class free of charge up to 2 hours before the start. Later cancellations count as a no-show (£5 fee charged through Paystride).

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Waitlist size: TBD with ops. When a spot opens, the first person on the waitlist gets it automatically.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: A member can hold at most 10 future bookings per week. Class capacity comes from ClubDesk (usually 20–25).

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Tiers: Basic (off-peak only), Premium (all hours, all clubs, 2 guest passes per month), Black (Premium + towels, sauna, 4 guest passes per month).

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Freeze for 1–3 months, once per year. Needs Paystride pause support — see open questions.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Check-in history: kept for visit statistics, retention period to be confirmed by PulseFit DPO. Payment data stays in Paystride.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Firebase Analytics with consent, no third-party ad SDKs.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Sprint 1–4: 23 Feb – 10 April. Store submission 10 April, public release 14 April 2026 on the App Store and Google Play.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: Launch marketing is run by PulseFit's marketing team. Brightloop provides deep links and store assets.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: PulseFit owns the Apple Developer account (£79 per year) and the Google Play account. Brightloop gets admin access.

units.author: Nora Quinn
units.text: 1) Retention of check-ins. 2) Paystride pause API for freeze. 3) Waitlist size. 4) Which clubs get door readers first.
